summary: Reproduced silent top-k value loss from a >2048-element fp16 coarse threshold bin on the actual gfx950 JIT implementation, then applied and verified the progressive exact-key refinement from upstream candidate PR #37941 for the register and streaming paths. The CUDA-only cluster path still contains the truncation and was not runnable on the assigned AMD GPU, so this is not claimed as a complete fix for the reported B200 batch-1 262K fixture.

tests.what_was_measured: On AMD Instinct MI350X gfx950, the unfixed streaming 262144x2048 case and register 8192x2048 case each had 2048/2048 selected-value mismatches versus torch.topk while returning 2048 valid unique indices; a 2048-candidate boundary and a 5000-way exact tie had zero value mismatches. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ba6b2cef8ee1/logs/before_repro.txt
10/10 exact narrow-bin regression and boundary/control cases passed across the gfx950 register and streaming paths. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ba6b2cef8ee1/logs/after_regression.txt
All 288 top-k v2 tests passed on gfx950. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ba6b2cef8ee1/logs/full_topk_v2.txt

The same streaming overflow, register overflow, non-overflow boundary, and exact-tie control all had zero selected-value mismatches versus torch.topk, with 2048 valid unique outputs. Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ba6b2cef8ee1/logs/after_repro.txt

Actual gfx950 code-object metadata from the rebuilt JIT library: paged kernels use 58-62 VGPRs, 19200 or 27392 bytes group segment, and 0 bytes private segment (no spills). Raw output: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-ba6b2cef8ee1/logs/gfx950_isa_metadata.txt; loaded library: /job/.cache/sglang/jit/gfx950/sgl_kernel_jit_dpsk_v4_topk_v2/build-19843f518534d173/deps-671843af4f1edc96/sgl_kernel_jit_dpsk_v4_topk_v2.so

gpu_execution.evidence: Executed before/after numerical comparisons and the complete test_topk_v2.py suite on the single assigned AMD Instinct MI350X, gfx950:sramecc+:xnack-.

remaining_limitations: The CUDA-only TopKCluster path still truncates threshold-bin candidates at kMaxNumTie. The issue's batch-1, N=262144 B200 fixture selects that path, so the original CUDA reproduction remains unverified and is not claimed fixed.
No B200/CUDA device, GLM-5.2 weights, dumped real score rows, full model serving run, or multi-node/TP8 environment was available.
The modified HIP JIT extension was freshly compiled and loaded, but REPOSITORY.md defines no separate native rebuild target; therefore native_rebuilt is false.
